questions.question: What promise about the heart does God give the exiles in chapter 11?
options: A hardened heart that would never turn back
A divided heart, torn between two masters
A new heart and a new spirit, removing the heart of stone
A cold heart of stone set in place of their hearts of flesh
questions.answer: A new heart and a new spirit, removing the heart of stone

questions.question: What did the wicked leaders of the city falsely say?
options: We must turn and repent of all our sins before it is far too late
The day of the LORD has now come at last, and the end is very near
Let us all flee away at once to Egypt, where we will surely be safe
The city is the cauldron and they are the meat (safe inside)
questions.answer: The city is the cauldron and they are the meat (safe inside)

questions.question: At the end of chapter 11 the glory of the LORD departed and stood on the mountain east of the city.
I will give them one heart, and a new _____ I will put within them.
I will remove the heart of _____ from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh.
